plugins.name: hello
plugins.label: Example, a plugin to copy
plugins.author: Shikshan Nivesh
plugins.what: An example, for anyone who wants to write a plugin: the smallest one there is, one screen that reads a desk address and one block a note can carry. If you did not mean to build a plugin you do not need it; remove it from Settings under Plugins and nothing changes.

plugins.name: terminal
plugins.label: Terminal door
plugins.author: Shikshan Nivesh
plugins.what: Lets the Ask box answer through an app already on this computer that you pay for another way (Claude Code on a Claude subscription, Codex on ChatGPT, Gemini CLI on a Google account, Kimi Code, Grok Build, Qwen Code, Cursor), with the same screen data and your notes, so no separate AI key is needed. It has no screen of its own: the apps it found, and the buttons to use one for Ask or sign in, are on Settings under Your AI.
talks_to: the coding agent on this computer, which reaches its own provider with its own login
